hero.label: Mason High School
hero.title:
Come for the workshops.
Stay and run a hackathon.
hero.lead: Interested in computer science, IT, or anything in between? Mason Hack Club is open to all students: workshops, hackathons, guest speakers, and more.

lead.text: Ohio's largest high school student-led hackathon.
lead.note: That's CincyHacks, and club members run every part of it.

aside.text: Open to all students. No experience needed.

whoWeAre.title: A club for students who build.
whoWeAre.text: We're a student-run chapter of Hack Club, a global network of high school coding clubs. We meet every week, and beginners sit next to experienced coders to learn, build, and ship projects. We're also the team behind CincyHacks, backed by our sponsors InfoTrust and Encore.

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.text: Hands-on sessions where you learn a skill and leave with something you built.

hackathons.title: Hackathons
hackathons.text: Build a project from scratch in a weekend, including our own event, CincyHacks.

speakers.title: Guest Speakers
speakers.text: People working in tech share what they do and how they got there.

goals.title: Where we're headed
goals.text: Our goals for this year and beyond.

attendees.title: More CincyHacks attendees
attendees.text: Bring more students from across the region to CincyHacks every year.

growth.title: More growth
growth.text: Grow club membership and help every member ship their first project.

reach.title: More reach
reach.text: Partner with more schools, sponsors, and the local tech community.

learning.title: More learning opportunities
learning.text: Run more workshops and bring in more guest speakers from the industry.

accomplishments.title: What we've done so far

feature.title: The largest high school student-led hackathon in Ohio.
feature.text: CincyHacks is organized entirely by Mason Hack Club students, from planning and sponsorships to running the event.

highlights: Hosted Ohio's largest high school student-led hackathon
Partnered with sponsors InfoTrust and Encore

sponsors.title: Thank you to our sponsors
sponsors.text: Their support makes our events and workshops possible.

hero.title: Do your *tasks.*
hero.lead: Four Among Us-style minigames built by club members. Each one takes under a minute.

reactor.title: Systems Check
reactor.text: A pattern lights up slowly on the left panel. Mirror it on the right without hitting a wrong cell.
reactor.hint: The demo machine needs a reboot sequence. Repeat the pattern.

setroute.title: Set Your Route
setroute.text: Drag the marker onto the ring, then do it again. Five rounds, and arrow keys work too.
setroute.hint: Registration is open. Line the marker up with the target, five times over.

popups.title: The Morning Of
popups.text: Close every pop-up against the clock. A new one opens every 4 seconds, and every misclick opens 2 more.
popups.hint: The check-in laptop has opinions. Clear the screen before it buries you.

flappy.title: While You Wait
flappy.text: No finish line. Tap, click, or press space to flap and see how far you get. Your best run is saved.
flappy.hint: The badge queue is long and somebody left this open. See how far you get.
